notes: Read-only P0 bound Script ID recovery after Agent 1.1.51 surfaced canonical FAILED/BINDING_VERIFY with NOTEBOOKLM_EXISTING_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND. This release does not create or run a queue task, launch a browser, login OAuth, create Apps Script projects/deployments/triggers, push remote code, publish, or spend credits. It decodes only the existing local clasp identity email when available, runs clasp list read-only, scans local/Drive/Chrome History and Session bytes with FileShare ReadWrite/Delete for the previously evidenced Script-ID prefix, and if exactly one 57-char candidate is recovered it uses clasp clone to a temp folder for read-only signature verification. A candidate is only marked readyForOnePush when clone succeeds and NotebookLM queue/bridge signatures score >=160. Existing Agent 1.1.51 governance remains pinned and runs afterward.
